assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's one curated REVIEWED item at basis_commit, read end to end with its front matter: the canonical character monograph series/fx-fighter-kurumi-chan/characters/kogane-mochiko-manga.md (FXK-P005, version 1.0, 99,753 bytes, status canonical), a self-contained portrait of the Japanese collected manga main narrative V01-V10 to V10 i0156 (24 April 2017), located by volume and page occurrence (Vnn iNNNN) and by the project's observation, claim and open-question IDs (FXK-Vnn-Ennn, FXK-Vnn-Cnnn, FXK-SYN-Cnnn, Vnn-Unn), with brief Japanese quotations. Its publication note records an independent self-containment PASS, a fidelity PASS after revision, a monograph-only retrieval probe and forty-one re-opened pages. Paratext, later volumes and adaptations are excluded by the monograph itself. The volume readings, the decision and evidence ledger, Studies B and C and the audits it cites are not curated on this subject, and no claim rests on them directly. No primary source page was inspected for this assessment.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: V01-V10 story time to V10 i0156 (24 April 2017), in located states: the V05 flashback of spring 2006 to April 2014 (late revelation, her own memories at every later state); V01-V02 (May-July 2014), the watcher with a soft public voice and a coarse private one; V03-V04 (July-November 2014), deception and the 109.5% loan toward Mebuki; V05 (November-December 2014), the first unmasking and the lie exposed; V06 (December 2014), one protective question to Kurumi and chosen silence; V07 (December 2014-January 2015), interior change, the disclosure of her schooling and the unsent message, with no change yet in conduct; V08 (January 2015), the intervention after Mebuki names her inaction (i0107), so V08 is split at i0107-i0114; V09 (2015 to April 2017), care with conditions and the employer role; V10 (April 2017), two short office scenes. Secrets the page never reveals to others (the 2012 'sample' thought, the V07 account of use) are hers at every state after they occur. Nothing after V10 i0156 is evidence.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution); evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The monograph separates a creed she states (only results count, 自己責任, trust as weakness, charity only on terms; section 3.1) from conduct that departs from it, and gives conditional regularities with counterexamples: with her own money she cuts by rule and keeps size modest (V05 i0034-i0035; V03 i0152; V07 i0063); faced with another's weakness she asks first what it means for her book, so panic becomes a signal and need a priced loan (section 4.3, INFERENCE MODERATE-HIGH); before V08 a friend at real risk draws one question and then silence (V06 i0151-i0154; FXK-V07-C009); when she acts against the doctrine she names the act in its vocabulary (投資, 打算, 施し; V08 i0113-i0114). It predicts her overreach and errors: the lies and the canary, the loan with the family as security, the withheld warnings, the use of force. Not A: her motive toward Kurumi is UNRESOLVED among five rivals (section 13.1), why she changes is unsettled (section 11.4), and the profile is untested. Not C: the account discriminates by stake, relationship, audience and dated state and says where it stops.

Section 11.1 dates the course by volume and section 11.3 separates late revelation (the V05 biography; the V07 account of the friendship's origin) from change drawn on the page. Section 11.2 lists what changes, each dated (relish V01-V03, thinning V04, absent from V05; deception absent from V06; the oldest lie ended with an apology at V07 i0046; address to Mebuki from 芽吹ちゃん to 芽吹 at V07 i0017; coarse register from contempt to care at V08 i0126) and what does not (doctrine, trading discipline, deflection, distance from family, no restitution to Mebuki). The V08 turn is located at Mebuki's question (i0107) and the decision pages (i0111-i0114). Not A: why she changes is left among five drivers (section 11.4), the post-V08 state rests on one sequence, and V10 is too thin to show further change. Not C: the states are located with causes stated as far as the page allows, and the rival readings are kept.

Section 6 constrains her Japanese closely: 私 throughout (私ら once), never あたし; an address table by listener with its shifts and occasions (くるみ, くるみちゃん when giving Kurumi away, 芽吹ちゃん to 芽吹 from V07, やす子, さん to 2017 staff, です/ます to adults as a child); the ちゃん rule (refused from peers, given downward; V05 i0045, i0052); six registers with dated examples (soft hedged public voice and the assent formula V01-V05; coarse masculine private voice; candour to the cat; trader's and creditor's jargon; plain dry casual and commands from V07; 2017 business brevity); and systematic inner-outer pairs (V01 i0069-i0070, i0094-i0095; V03 i0126) that cross in V07-V08. Not A: her voice is lettering, several attributions are graded (section 6.5), and the 2017 register rests on a few lines. Not C: forms, shifts and their triggers are located across ten volumes.

Sections 5.1 and 8 give a stable ordinary life across volumes: market-watching in class, a four-monitor desk, a wall of textbooks, the white cat she talks to, cat goods she never mentions, heavily sweetened café coffee with roasted tea as her stated favourite (V07 i0048), bookstore browsing, cooking for Kurumi (V07 i0058; V09 i0013-i0016), 'ごちそうさまでした' when taking profit, sitting apart, and in 2017 crunch-mode typing and brief delegation (V10 i0010, i0063). Situational acts are kept apart from preferences, and one change is dated (the bath refused in V07, offered in V08). Not A: hobbies beyond markets, making and reading are not shown, and her 2017 private life is almost blank. Not C: the habits recur across settings and volumes with locators.

Section 7 reads each tie in both directions and dates it by volume: Kurumi (2012 'sample', V01-V05 watcher and tempter, V06-V07 silent witness, V08 rescuer, V09-V10 employer and private friend; Kurumi's trust constant); Mebuki (adviser, concealed counterparty, creditor at 109.5%, then candour without remorse at V07 i0017 and no restitution); Yasuko (contempt and real delight, a day of protection, resentment at being known, a client relationship); her mother, grandmother and the bespectacled man (V05); 2017 staff. Conduct is conditioned on standing (the ちゃん rule), on whether she holds the other side (section 4.3), on who knows what (the knowledge boundaries of section 7.1) and on chronology. Not A: her family appears only in flashback, her staff ties are a few lines, and no page shows Kurumi learning of the 2012 'sample' or the V03 disclosure. Not C: her conduct varies by relationship in located, explained ways.

The page gives her a private voice from her first chapter: thought balloons, burst balloons and narration in her own words, systematically paired with her speech in V01-V05 (section 6.4), the 2012 'sample' thought (V05 i0048), the V07 interior account of use (i0045), the self-question 'なにがしたかったんだろう' (V07 i0139), the unsent message and anguish (V07 i0099-i0100), and the V08 decision narrated (i0111-i0114). Not A: several load-bearing attributions are graded (V01 i0159; V06 i0154 at MODERATE-HIGH; V07 i0045 at MODERATE-HIGH), and her interior in 2015-2017 is almost absent. Not C: her interior is directly lettered across volumes, and the gap between inner and outer speech is a located, recurring sign.

The monograph locates modes: in V01-V05 she avoids open conflict with the assent formula ('ここは適当に 合わせるか…', V03 i0126); charged or questioned, she refuses or falls silent first (V05 i0136; V07 i0045; V08 i0122); open conflict comes under drink and provocation (V05 i0137) or in anger (V07 i0135); in V08 force is deliberate and in service of a question (i0125-i0136); caught in a lie by friends, she shrugs (V05 i0144-i0146). Section 5.7 states the regularity 'first response to pressure is silence; action, when it comes, is sudden and total'. Not B: the outburst and the use of force each rest on one scene (section 12 grades the drink row LOW-MODERATE), and what turns silence into confrontation, beyond one sequence with a third party's prompt, is not established. Not D: each mode is located with examples and counterconditions.

Her stated moral reasoning is located: 自己責任 extended from Mebuki to Kurumi in an inner decision (V06 i0154); 'others cannot be helped' (V07 i0135); a creditor's refusal to pay another's debt 'even with a billion yen' (V08 i0119); wanting separated from obligation (V08 i0133-i0138); telling one's father as the test of adulthood and the condition of a job (V09 i0043, i0050); rare explicit moral vocabulary ('ダメでしょ 道徳的に…!', V07 i0098); and honesty about her own taste for kicking the ruined (V07 i0134). The discovery row claims no ethics dimension, and this grade claims no broader moral or political reasoning. Not B: her conduct departs from the stated reasoning, and the monograph leaves open what decides the V06-V07 silence (respect, realism, self-protection or negligence) and the V08 action (attachment or interest; sections 4.4, 13.1), so the deciding consideration in a new case is not established. Not D: the reasoning in each located case is on the page.

Section 6.3 documents dry, deadpan humour with examples ('この場で 言わない ランキング 第1位だわ', V08 i0119; '秒で寝るじゃん', i0158; '破産おめでと' with a gazette page, V09 i0105), mischievous rules-lawyering (V07 i0021-i0025), and a dated change of function: teasing keeps people at a distance in V02 ('いいよ… / やってみな…?') and is a way of caring in V08-V09. Not B: the evidence describes a style and its dated function but does not establish what decides when play appears in ordinary scenes, beyond these examples. Not D: the style is specific and located across volumes.

She appears in every volume, with a private voice from her first chapter and a seventy-page V05 biography; the curated monograph covers the full V01-V10 boundary, re-opened forty-one pages to verify its quotations and attributions (section 14.4), passed independent self-containment and fidelity checks, and was probed by a context that read only the portrait. Its claims carry locators and graded labels. Not A: the assessment rests on one derived portrait; the readings, ledger and studies that carry the underlying observations are not curated on this subject; the qualification audit rates V10 sufficiency LOW. Not C: coverage of the admitted boundary is comprehensive rather than sampled.

The monograph states affirmative limits and contradictions: cruelty as an end is not established in any volume, and relish is absent from V05 on even when ruin is real (section 3.6; FXK-V08-C063); no exploitation of Kurumi's vulnerability and no gain from her loss is shown (FXK-V07-C075); no deception is shown after V06 (section 5.5); her own large losses are never shown, so the profile abstains at untested scales; the contradictions of section 3.4 (private conduct harsher than public speech through V05, stated beliefs harsher than conduct from V07); what is never corrected (no apology or restitution to Mebuki; no answer to Kurumi's V08 charge); and an explicit abstention list (section 12). Not A: some limits rest on silence rather than contrary conduct. Not C: the limits are stated affirmatively and located.

States carry dates, ages and locators: 12 in spring 2006, 20 in May 2014, 23 in April 2017 (section 1); balances on 15 July, 19 September and 8 December 2014 (section 2.1); 7 January 2015 for the disclosure of her schooling; the V08 night in January 2015; autumn 2015 for the loan nearly repaid; April 2017 for the office. Section 11.1 dates the course by volume and the V08 turn is located within the volume. Not A: some dates are unprinted (the company's founding, her December close time, much of 2015-2017), and whether she held a position on 15 January 2015 is not shown (V07-U15). Not C: the chronology is explicit and fine-grained across the boundary.

conditions: Output is illustrative written Japanese, never quotation; her voice is lettering, so no pitch, tempo or performed delivery is claimed (section 6.5).
Self-reference is 私; address forms follow the section 6.1 table for the sampled listener and date, including 芽吹ちゃん before V07 i0017 and 芽吹 after, and さん to 2017 staff.

Register follows the dated listener and setting of section 6.2: soft hedged public voice and the assent formula with a coarse inner voice in V01-V05; plain dry casual, commands and deadpan from V07; business brevity in the 2017 office; candour to the cat.
Inner and outer speech diverge in V01-V05 by the located pairs of section 6.4; from V08 the coarse register may carry care in the open.
Praise or closeness is deflected in words ('べ… 別に…', '大袈裟'); questions about her past draw refusal or silence first.
The interlocutor is Kurumi, Mebuki, Yasuko, a 2017 staff member, a stranger at an event, or her cat; another peer is a separate, lower-confidence condition limited to the register rules.
scenario_readiness.note: The address table, registers by date and listener, the ちゃん rule and the inner-outer pairs constrain illustrative Japanese closely enough for bounded use. Not READY: the evidence is lettering, attributions are graded in places and the 2017 voice is a few lines. Not NOT_READY: the forms and their triggers are located across ten volumes.

conditions: A decision about her own position in any named state: predict a cut by rule or a stop set in advance, early and small, with no averaging down; abstain on scales larger than the page tests (section 12).

A friend's panic or need she can use, in a V03-V05 state where she holds the other side: predict use as information or a loan on hard terms, possibly with concealment of her position. From V06 the no-lies rule binds her; abstain on exploitation in 2017.
A request to give or lend money: predict terms (rate, IOU, security) or refusal on a creditor's logic, with small cash courtesies as counterexamples (V04 i0118; V01 i0065).

A friend at real risk who will not be helped, before V08: predict one protective question, then silence citing 自己責任, with private distress. From V08, once a trusted third party names her inaction: predict that she comes, uses blunt questions and force if needed, names practical routes, gives no money and attaches a condition. Whether she acts without such a prompt is not predicted.
Praise, thanks or closeness: deflection in words with acceptance in deed. A rule she accepted or a condition she set: kept to the letter and enforced.
Include her overreach and errors: concealment and the lie in V01-V05, use of a friend's weakness, withheld warnings, force in V08, and doctrine cited as a reason not to act.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state from the temporal boundary: V01-V02 watcher; V03-V05 deception and credit; V06-V07 silence (V07 with interior change and no lies); V08 after Mebuki's question at i0107; or V09-V10 employer. Her V05 history and the 2012 'sample' thought belong to her at every later state; what others never learn (the 'sample', the V03 disclosure to Mebuki, the 狂人 label, the V07 withheld warnings) stays unknown to them in every state.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Kurumi as friend, then employee; Mebuki as admirer, debtor and later the person who reads her; Yasuko as friend and client; 2017 staff; a stranger at an event. Another peer is a separate, lower-confidence transfer; her mother, family beyond the V05 flashback, romantic partners and figures of authority over her are unsampled in present time.
setting_constraints: Contemporary Japan within her located circumstances: university, her flat and trading desk, cafés and a sushi bar, Yasuko's event, Mebuki's salon, Kurumi's flat, the 2017 office.
No real market history, no market outcome invented to settle a prediction, no post-V10 events, no present-time family meeting, no romantic or intimate scene and no cross-series setting.

scenario_readiness.note: Bounded extrapolation supported by a conditional profile with counterconditions and an explicit abstention list. Not READY: her motive is unresolved, the post-V08 rows rest on one sequence, and the profile is untested as a model. Not NOT_READY: the conditions that change her choices are located and stated.

conditions: Settings sampled by the monograph: lectures and the student lounge, her flat with the cat and trading desk, café meetings, the friends' meals and contest dinners, Yasuko's event, Mebuki's salon, cooking or caring for Kurumi, and the 2017 office.
Predict dry assent or deadpan, sitting apart, chart-checking at the table, sweetened coffee, cat goods never mentioned, and practical help given in act and disowned in word (section 5.2).
In V01-V05 public pleasantness may cover private contempt; from V07 her talk is plainer.
Her 2017 private life, hobbies beyond markets, making and reading, and friends outside the circle are not established and are not filled in.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary conduct located across ten volumes, bounded to the sampled settings and dated states. Not READY: the 2017 private life is almost blank and the V01-V05 inner-outer split must be applied. Not NOT_READY: the habits and their settings are located.

conditions: Obligations over money, help, honesty and disclosure among Kurumi, Mebuki and Yasuko, in a named state.

Predict the stated reasoning by state: 自己責任 and 'others cannot be helped' through V07; a creditor's logic on debt at every state; wanting separated from obligation and honesty with one's family set as a condition from V08-V09.

Predict that her conduct may depart from the stated reasoning in the located direction for the state (harsher than her words through V05, kinder than her words from V07), without asserting which motive decides.
Moral, political or institutional questions beyond her own ties are not evidenced and are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Her reasoning is on the page in each located case, so bounded prediction of what she says is supported. Not READY: what decides her conduct where it departs from the reasoning is unresolved. Not NOT_READY: the doctrine, its dated departures and its stable core are located.

Not assessed: the monograph marks the dimension UNTESTED and says nothing is to be filled in (section 9). The evidence boundary is recorded as the intimate-untested known limit. No state is claimed either way, so this records no finding about how she would behave in a romantic situation.

conditions: Her own trading: process over prediction, with loss-cuts by rule, a stop, moderate leverage and profit taken; forecasts hedged in public and admitted wrong in private (section 4.2).
As a creditor: terms, security and a creditor's logic (V04; V08 i0119).

Advising or watching another trader in whom she has no stake: a risk reading at once, then encouragement in V01-V02, one process question in V06, or the name of the strategy with her reservation kept private in V09.

The 2017 office: brief delegation, crunch-mode work, cool rules with occasional warmth to a junior, at LOW-MODERATE support. Her company's business, her view of her staff's trading and Kizuna's open position at V10's end are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Located professional conduct in her own trading, as a creditor and as an employer. Not READY: the 2017 role is lightly sampled and the company's business is never printed. Not NOT_READY: the trading rows are HIGH with counterconditions.

known_limits.statement: Her motive toward Kurumi stays UNRESOLVED among observation and use as a long con, attachment grown out of use, narrative function, wanting company in the market and the rescue as recruitment (section 13.1; FXK-V01-C005 to FXK-V09-C070). The monograph's preferred account is INFERENCE MODERATE.
Why she changes between V07 and V09 is left among five possible drivers (recognition, real ruin and her own silence, a third party, interest, narrative function), none settled (section 11.4).

Her V08 action followed Mebuki's naming of her inaction (V08 i0107-i0110); whether she would now act without a prompt, or what she would do if Kurumi traded again, is an abstention in the profile (section 12).
The V06-V07 silence is read as respect for autonomy, realism, self-protection or negligence, with none asserted (V06 reading counterreading 4; V07 reading counterreading 2).
Nothing after V10 i0156 is evidence; outcomes facing later events are not scoreable, and the profile abstains on her motives after 2015.
Her voice is lettering and balloon convention; several load-bearing attributions are graded (V01 i0159; V06 i0154; V07 i0045; V07 i0066), and a V09 i0146 line is unattributed.

The monograph's section 12 states that its operational profile is a summary of observed conditionals, not a reconstruction model, and has not been tested or validated; the monograph-only retrieval probe tests the portrait's self-containment, not predictions against held-out pages.

The monograph marks the romantic and intimate dimension UNTESTED: no attraction, history, partner, jealousy or intimate preference is shown, physical closeness appears only as friendship and care (V08 i0146-i0157), and nothing is to be filled in (section 9). This is an evidence boundary, not a finding about romantic behavior.
No large loss of her own is ever shown, so her trading rows hold only at the scales the page tests (section 12).
Part of her course may be the story's need for a rescuer who holds the figure (Study B §6.5, as the monograph reports it), which the monograph keeps as a live driver beside her psychology.

The volume readings, the decision and evidence ledger, the specialist studies and the audits that carry the underlying observations are not curated on this subject, so every claim here rests on the portrait's summaries and locators.

Her father, her mother after 2012, whether she graduated, the source of her starting capital, her company's business and capital, whether she held a position on 15 January 2015 (V07-U15) and her 2017 inner life are not printed.
